---
name: RFC / Design discussion
about: Propose a significant architectural or protocol change
labels: rfc
---

## Summary

One paragraph: what are you proposing and why?

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Why does it matter? Link to any existing issues.

## Detailed design

Describe the change in detail. Include:
- Interface or API changes (with code examples if applicable)
- Data model changes
- Migration path for existing deployments
- Protocol changes (for TPT Credit chain changes — these require extra scrutiny as many are irreversible)

## Drawbacks

What are the downsides or risks of this approach?

## Alternatives

What other approaches were considered and rejected?

## Unresolved questions

What still needs to be figured out?
